events.name: CellClick
events.description: The user clicks a cell, a header or a row header.
events.useCase: Open a detail view for the clicked row.

events.name: CellValueChanged
events.description: The value of a cell changes after editing.
events.useCase: Recalculate a total when a quantity is edited.

events.name: CellEndEdit
events.description: The user finishes editing a cell.

events.name: SelectionChanged
events.description: The selection of cells or rows changes.
events.useCase: Update a details panel for the selected row.

events.name: DataError
events.description: A cell value cannot be converted or a data operation fails.
events.useCase: Replace the default error dialog with your own message.

events.name: CellFormatting
events.description: A cell is about to be displayed.

events.name: CurrentChanged
events.useCase: Update controls that are not bound.

events.name: ListChanged
events.description: The list or an item in it changes.
events.useCase: Refresh totals when rows are added, removed or edited.

events.name: PositionChanged
DataSourceChanged
events.useCase: Rebuild the columns or reset filters.

events.name: RefreshItems
events.description: The navigator updates the state of its buttons.
events.useCase: Enable or disable your own extra buttons at the same time.
